final: SELECT s1.rating, s1.avg_price_per_day, s1.avg_price_per_day - s2.overall_avg AS difference FROM (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film f WHERE f.replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY f.rating) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(temp.avg_price_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film f WHERE f.replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY f.rating) temp) s2 WHERE s1.avg_price_per_day > s2.overall_avg ORDER BY s1.rating
